Hi Samantha / Tom - great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from today's discovery: 

- Mutual Action Plan (MAP): attached draft (Acme_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf). Key milestones called out below.
- Legal milestone: Acme to review MSA/DPA/SLA redlines. We noted a few non-negotiables from our side (data residency, audit logs retention, and SLA credit terms).
- Commercial milestone: finalize committed capacity and pricing; Rishi will own final quote.
- Technical POC: sandbox access by 11/12; engineering contact Monica.

Milestone / owner / target date / dependency:
- MAP sign-off (Commercial & Legal) / Acme + Redwood / target 2026-11-30 / depends on MSA/DPA redlines turnaround
- Sandbox & integration testing / Acme Eng (Tom) + Redwood Eng (Monica) / start 2026-11-12 / depends on onboarding access
- Final PO / Acme procurement / target 2026-12-07 / depends on legal/finance approval

Legal redlines note: please send any redlines to legal@acme.com and cc rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai and marissa.cole@redwood.ai. Our suggested process: Acme redlines -> Redwood legal to respond with comment summary within 48 business hours -> if material changes, route to execs for approval.

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), Redwood_MSA_v2_redline.docx (Redwood's redline baseline).

Next steps: 
1) Samantha: confirm who on Acme Legal will own the redlines and target date for initial redline delivery (asked: by 11/09).
2) Rishi: produce committed capacity quote and PO template by EOD 11/06.
3) Monica: open sandbox access and share connection details by 11/12.

Thanks - I'll follow up mid-next-week on legal status.

For any material commercial changes (indemnity, liability caps, data residency commitments beyond our standard), expect escalation and ~3-5 business days once we loop in counsel.

- I'll prioritize the MSA/DPA once we receive the file; Monica, please be ready to pull technical artifact examples (network diagrams, retention configs) for legal if asked.

I'll coordinate the first-pass turnaround target to align with Samantha's 48-72 hour ask where possible.
